rounds.reason: Integration proof at the card's declared tests/integration/AUR-020.go path was dead code: a .go file without the _test.go suffix is invisible to go test's scanner, so the declared path could not carry a real Integration proof.

The working Integration test was delivered at a path the card did not own; the skeptic traced how oci-run silently skips a declared allowed_root absent from disk, leaving the deviation invisible to the sealed accept and to validate.sh alike. Escalated rather than silently accepted.

rounds.governance_change: Card version bump to v2 (commit 45d5013448fe1186cbccb1f5df68a2b0f132fb0c) retargeted the Integration path to tests/integration/AUR-020_test.go::TestAUR020Boundary, the only path go test can discover.

note: This bundle only proves round 3 against the current candidate; round 1/2 artifacts were produced against the pre-v2 card and are superseded, not persisted here as live evidence for the current spec_digest.
